chose: a tsconfig or jsconfig decides tsgo or tsserver only when it is the project's own (keepProjectFiles) and the walk bounded by the config's ignore list reads it (exclusionOf over walkBounds(root))
over: every tracked config anywhere; or only configs covering a file the adapter reads
because: one removed option in a fixture, example or vendored package sent the whole project to tsserver (PostHog refuses at nodejs/tsconfig.test.json); the ignore list is where the adoption already says a folder is not its concern, and a reference from an ignored folder through a removed option is the accepted cost
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
